module: Flowgraph node "Abandon Delivery" (category once_instant, tags delivery/mission). Abandons the current delivery and tears down the system (vehicles, UI elements, state) via gameplay_freeformDelivery_freeformDelivery.teardown. Input pins: flow, reset (hidden), keepVehicles (bool: keeps the vehicles by taking them out of the prefabs). Outputs: flow, success.

init.desc: Sets flow and success to false.

reset.desc: Resets flow and success to false.

work.desc: If flow is active: calls teardown(keepVehicles) and signals success; logs an error if the delivery system is absent.
